servinfo.title: Engine hesitates – Momentary lack of response as accelerator is depressed. Can occur at all vehicle speeds. Usually severest when moving out from a stop at stop signal, etc.
servinfo.ptxt: Perform troubleshooting referring to the following points when ECM has detected no DTC and no abnormality has been found in Visual Inspection:K14D and Engine Basic Inspection:K14D .

condition.ptxt: Engine hesitates – Momentary lack of response as accelerator is depressed. Can occur at all vehicle speeds. Usually severest when moving out from a stop at stop signal, etc.
